expected.notes: Payday morning, Fri 30 Oct 2026, the pay not yet in the balance and not yet posted: the salary (3,000, history 31 Jul, 28 Aug, 25 Sep) is expected today into Barclays Premier, so the walks credit it once, correctly. Pay period last Friday: the period runs 30 Oct to Thu 26 Nov (28 days; next payday Fri 27 Nov). Accounts: Barclays Premier (salary account) 3,000; Monzo Current 400; Barclays Japan Pot (savings) 300; Monzo Challenge Pot (savings) 500. Bills: Premier mortgage 900 (Mon 2 Nov, day 3); Monzo gym 30 (Tue 10 Nov, day 11). Two goals, each with a STORED source account. Japan trip: 1,200 by 31 Mar 2027, funded from Premier into the Japan pot (baseline 300 = balance, so progress 0 and 1,200 remaining). Pay-period starts after this period and up to 31 Mar: Fri 27 Nov, 25 Dec, 29 Jan, 26 Feb, 26 Mar = 5, so 6 periods in all and the slice is 1,200 / 6 = 200 (already a multiple of 5). 4p challenge: a fixed daily step, 4p on 1 Jan 2026 rising 4p a day for 365 days (total 4 x 365 x 366 / 2 = 267,180p = 2,671.80), drawn from Monzo Current into the challenge pot (counting its 500 balance as progress, so 2,171.80 remains, more than a period asks). Day number is the day of the year, 30 Oct is day 303 and 26 Nov is day 330, so the period asks for the sum of 303 to 330 = 28 x (303 + 330) / 2 = 8,862 steps of 4p = 35,448p = 354.48. Plans reserved = 200 + 354.48 = 554.48. Left to spend: pool = counted current accounts only = 3,000 + 400 = 3,400 (the two savings pots are in no pool). Walk: opening 3,400; day 0 + 3,000 = 6,400; day 3 - 900 = 5,500; day 11 - 30 = 5,470. The lowest point is the opening 3,400 (the pay is credited the same morning, after it), so 3,400 - 554.48 = 2,845.52. Positions (G352 and G238: every goal slice is reserved at its SOURCE account): Premier walk 3,000 + 3,000 (day 0) = 6,000 - 900 = 5,100, after payments 5,100, low point 3,000 (opening); plans reserved 200 (Japan); after payments and plans 4,900; low point and plans 2,800; Spend from min(4,900, 2,800) = 2,800, under the pool 2,845.52. Monzo walk: 400 - 30 = 370, after payments 370, low point 370 (below the opening 400); plans reserved 354.48 (the challenge); after payments and plans 15.52; Spend from 15.52. No goal appears at a pot: the Japan and challenge pots hold no plans and no payday move. Payday plan (live, because no salary credit has posted; it prices from the live balance and the salary account is the income candidate's account, Premier): Premier keeps its bills 900 (the mortgage is not an own transfer), no everyday spend history, the 50 buffer, and the 200 Japan slice sourced at Premier (G350: kept in the salary account, never routed to the pot): target 900 + 50 + 200 = 1,150, distributable 3,000 - 1,150 = 1,850. Destinations: the two pots are savings with no habitual funding and no bills, so no move. Monzo is the source of the 354.48 challenge need: its own target is gym 30 + buffer 50 = 80 and the balance 400 is above it by 320, so only the remainder of the need is added: 354.48 - 320 = 34.48 (exact pennies, G350), the move into Monzo with the reason set-aside or goal named 4p challenge. Plan total 34.48, one destination (Monzo), covered (34.48 is under 1,850). The salary account keeps 200 for Japan. Cover plan: nobody is short (both accounts positive on every measure), so no cover move; at risk 0. Standing headroom (the figure the cover-plan finder and the payday plan read, G352): each account's own lowest running balance less what it reserves for goals at that source less the 10 every source keeps. CORRECT: Premier 3,000 - 200 - 10 = 2,790; Monzo 370 - 354.48 - 10 = 5.52. CURRENT behaviour, pinned: the goal slices that headroom and the payday plan's source needs read come from _goal_source_slices, whose query projection omits the goal's schedule (the commitments query in companion.py's _goal_source_slices lacks the schedule field that _active_commitment_slices has), so the daily goal is sized as equal slices instead: remaining 2,171.80 over the periods to its 31 Dec 2026 end (this one, 27 Nov and 25 Dec = 3) is 723.93, rounded up to the next 5 = 725. Monzo headroom is then 370 - 725 - 10 = -365 (reads short). In the payday plan the need is 725: target 30 + 50 + 725 = 805, the balance 400 is 320 over the natural target of 80, so the move is 725 - 320 = 405 (not 34.48), the salary account stays 3,000 - 1,150 = 1,850 distributable, plan total 405, covered, with the reason line 4p challenge at 725 instead of 354.48. So the positions (354.48, through the account-plan list that does read the schedule) and the headroom and plan (725) disagree about the same goal. Known backend gaps (G350, G351, G352): acc-monzo headroom, payday_plan total, dests and reasons; they stop being gaps when _goal_source_slices reads the schedule, and the run then fails until they are deleted and the expectations set to the correct figures.
